description: Main-window capability. The webview gets no filesystem plugin at all: markdown and image reads go through validated Rust commands (read_file / read_image_file), and export writes go through write_export_file, a single atomic create-or-overwrite of the path the user picked in a save dialog. An earlier fs plugin grant with a ** scope let any script in the webview read, list and overwrite every file the user could. SECURITY-02.
